summary: Iteration-scope review completed for module `feedback`, iteration 1. The current plan, elaborated requirements, and test design are consistent with the clarified single-iteration objective: create a greenfield Next.js TypeScript SaaS landing page with a BFF foundation, header, horizontal navigation, footer, responsive accessibility expectations, Playwright coverage, and traceable delivery evidence. Evidence reviewed confirms seven planned story IDs in planning, matching seven elaborated requirement stories, and test design coverage mapping all seven stories to 29 test cases. Scope is appropriately bounded: final production copy, authentication, feedback submission, persistence, admin review workflows, deployment, publishing, and exact OpenAI cloning are explicitly out of scope. Technical readiness is adequate for implementation; no missing prerequisite or technical blocker was found. No tests were run during this read-only architecture review.
